report:
I found nothing that needs fixing, so this can be merged.

**Root cause and fix:** `node.routes()` in `tree.go` used to skip a whole tree node whenever that node held a `Route`/`Mount` stub (the placeholder handler registered at the mount path) and had no subroutes. So a real `GET /foo/bar` sharing the stub's node was dropped too. The PR adds a `stub` flag to each `endpoint`, set in `setEndpoint`. `routes()` now skips only the stubbed endpoints, not the whole node. A real handler registered later overwrites its method's endpoint and clears the flag. Endpoints that are still stubs stay hidden. `Walk` gets its list from `routes()`, so both `Walk` and `Routes()` are fixed.

**What I checked:**
- **Checks:** `gofmt -l .` printed nothing. `go vet ./...` was clean. `go test ./...` passed for both packages (`ok github.com/go-chi/chi/v5`, `ok .../middleware`). `go test -count=3 -shuffle=on .` also passed, so the new tests don't depend on test order, even though they add a method globally with `RegisterMethod`.
- **The tests catch the bug:** I put the new `tree_test.go` on top of a clean copy of HEAD in a temp directory. `TestWalkRouteStubCollisions` failed on HEAD, for example: `expected [GET /foo/bar GET /foo/bar/{id}], got [GET /foo/bar/{id}]`. `TestWalkRouteStubMiddlewares` failed with `expected middleware counts map[GET /foo/bar:2 GET /foo/bar/{id}:1], got map[GET /foo/bar/{id}:1]`.
- **Nothing new is reported when there's no collision:** I ran the same probe against HEAD and the PR. It builds a router with `Get`, `Handle`, nested `Route`, `Mount` of a plain handler, `Mount` on a pattern ending in `/`, a mounted Mux with `/*`, `Group`, and an empty `Route`. The 46 lines of `Walk` output and the `Routes()` count were identical (`diff` printed `SAME`).
- **Edge cases the tests cover:** a `Get` registered before `Route` on the same pattern (the stub replaces it and it isn't served, so leaving it out is correct), a trailing-slash `POST`, `Handle` after `Route` (every method reported, no `*` entry), a custom method, a plain-handler `Mount` next to a `Get`, and middleware counts.
- **Scope:** only `tree.go` and `tree_test.go` changed. `CHANGELOG.md` only lists release links, so there's no entry to add. I left nothing in the repo, and `git status` is as I found it.

**Nits (none block the merge):**
- No test calls `Routes()` directly. It's only covered through `Walk`.
- `TestRouteStubCollisionServing` also passes on HEAD, because serving already worked. It guards against a future break rather than testing this fix.
- `RegisterMethod("CUSTOM")` permanently changes the global method table for the rest of the test run. `mux_test.go:1764` already does the same with `"BOO"`, so this follows existing practice.
